changelog: Phase 32B — Card-required signup + addon purchase API + trial-end reminder cron. (1) api/signup.php after tenant creation initiates 1 ₽ YK binding payment with save_payment_method=true; returns redirect_url to YK; js/signup.js redirects user to YK for card input. On YK success the payment-webhook handler saves payment_method to payment_methods and auto-refunds the 1 ₽ via new YookassaRecurring::refundPayment() — customer pays nothing for trial. Trial continues 90 days; first real Pro charge happens day 91 via billing-cycle-worker. (2) New lib/Billing/AddonCatalog.php with 10 SKUs (Express onboarding 9 900 ₽, Full onboarding 24 900 ₽, Migration from competitor 49 900 ₽, Group training 6 900 ₽, Individual training 4 900 ₽, Telegram-bot setup 4 900 ₽, Custom domain 2 900 ₽, Recorded video course 2 900 ₽, Priority support 990 ₽/mo, On-site visit 19 900 ₽). New sql/addons-migration.sql (addon_purchases table). New api/billing-purchase-addon.php endpoint (POST {addon_sku} → YK one-time payment, returns YK redirect_url). UI: 'Купить' buttons replace mailto: placeholder in partials/owner_billing_section.php; bundled-in-plan addons show 'Включено в ваш тариф' instead. SubscriptionStore::onWebhook short-circuits on addon payments — doesn't accidentally extend subscription period. (3) New scripts/billing-trial-reminder.php daily cron — finds tenants with trial expiring in 15 days and 5 days, sends reminder emails with billing-tab link. Idempotent via subscription_events dedup. Wire-up: 30 9 * * * /usr/bin/php8.1 .../scripts/billing-trial-reminder.php. (4) Annual billing automation deferred to Phase 32C — manual billing_period flag works for first 5-10 annual customers. Run sql/addons-migration.sql against control-plane DB after pull (idempotent). Updated docs/billing.md, docs/marketing-strategy-2026.md, docs/project-improvement-roadmap.md, docs/ops-runbook.md (cron section §2.4).
